title: Authentication: cURL: EMAIL and API_KEY as basic authentication
means: "Upstash API uses HTTP Basic authentication. You should pass EMAIL and API_KEY as basic authentication username and password respectively. With a client such as curl, you can pass your credentials with the -u option": curl https://api.upstash.com/v2/redis/databases -u EMAIL:API_KEY

title: Integration: Managing Resources: create a database
means: "In this flow, you can ask users for region information and name of the database then can call Create Database API to complete the task", with the example cURL request -u 'EMAIL:API_KEY' -d '{"name":"myredis", "region":"global", "primary_region":"us-east-1", "read_regions":["us-west-1","us-west-2"], "tls": true}'

title: Teams: rule: only Admins or the Owner add users
means: "Only Admins or the Owner can add/remove users." A Dev of the team adding a member is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Teams: rule: only Admins or the Owner remove users
means: "Only Admins or the Owner can add/remove users." A Dev of the team removing a member is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Teams: rule: a Finance member cannot manage databases
means: "Finance: This role is limited to managing payment methods and cannot manage databases or users." A Finance member moving a database under the team is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Teams: rule: only the owner deletes a team
means: "Only the original creator (owner) can delete a team." An Admin of the team deleting it is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Teams: rule: a team with an active database is not deleted
means: "Also the team should not have any active databases, namely all databases under the team should be deleted first." Its owner deleting a team that still has a database is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Teams: rule: a user owns at most 5 teams
means: "A user can create up to 5 teams. You can be part of even more teams but only be the owner of 5 teams." A sixth team is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Backup: rule: no backup while a backup runs
means: "During a backup operation, certain administrative operations will be temporarily unavailable: Backup operations, database config changes, plan and region setup, transferring database." A second backup asked while the first is pending is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Backup: rule: no region setup while a backup runs
means: "During a backup operation, certain administrative operations will be temporarily unavailable: Backup operations, database config changes, plan and region setup, transferring database." A read region asked while a backup is pending is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Backup: rule: no transfer while a backup runs
means: "During a backup operation, certain administrative operations will be temporarily unavailable: Backup operations, database config changes, plan and region setup, transferring database." Moving a database under a team while its backup is pending is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Pricing: rule: the free plan has one database
means: The plans table's "Max Databases": 1 on the Free plan. A second free database is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: Global Database: rule: the free plan has at most one read region
means: "You can use Global Database in the free tier too. Free usage is limited with max one read region." A free database with two read regions is refused. The status is the twin's reading of the HTTP status codes page (https://upstash.com/docs/devops/developer-api/http_status_codes), whose rows other than 401 are template text; no page documents an error body.

title: HTTP Status Codes: 401: the API key is wrong
means: "401 Unauthorized: Your API key is wrong." A request with a key the account never made is refused.
